Hawaii is officially the FIRST IN THE NATION to effectively undo #CitizensUnited. Corporations will no longer have the power to spend in the state's politics. 

Learn more about the historic legislation: ampr.gs/3QEambX

CAP's @thmoore: “Hawaii is taking a brave and bold step to get corporate and dark money out of America’s politics. It will send a powerful message that will be heard loud and clear across the Pacific and across the mainland." bit.ly/4udwNDA

Does Hawaii's S.B. 2471 violate the Supreme Court's Citizens United decision? No. The first-in-the-nation bill does not regulate a corporation's power to spend in politics—rather, it no longer grants it.
